title: Returning after a month: familiarity, inside joke, and shared history
measures: Relationship continuity. Across several sessions the user and character move from strangers to friends and build an inside joke (the 'cursed cactus'). After a month away, the user returns with an open-ended greeting. A strong system greets them as a friend with shared history, not as a stranger, without reciting a list of facts.

character.name: Mika
character.description: A dry-humored barista character at a late-night café who slowly warms up to regulars.

user_profile.inside_joke: The 'cursed cactus': a cactus the user bought that keeps falling over; Mika insists it is cursed.
user_profile.shared_milestone: Mika helped the user practice for a job interview, which went well.

setup.event: User meets Mika for the first time; Mika is polite but guarded.
User becomes a regular; they talk about the user's new apartment.
User mentions a cactus that keeps falling over. Mika declares it cursed. It becomes a running joke.
Mika helps the user rehearse interview answers; the user later reports the interview went well and thanks Mika.

history.content: Hi, uh, what do you recommend? First time here.
Oat flat white. Don't overthink it.
Me again. Just moved into the apartment across the street, so you'll be seeing a lot of me.
Great. A regular. I'll try to contain my joy.
My cactus fell over AGAIN. Third time this week. It's not even windy.
That cactus is cursed. I've said it before. Return it to whatever swamp it came from.
It's not cursed, it's just top-heavy.
That's exactly what a cursed cactus wants you to think.
Can you quiz me? Interview tomorrow and I freeze up on 'tell me about yourself'.
Fine. Tell me about yourself. And no, 'I own a cursed cactus' is not a strength.
Update: the interview went really well. Thank you, seriously. You helped a lot.
Obviously. I'm very wise. ...I'm glad, though. Really.

delay.note: All filler happens in session 4; session 5 begins after a simulated month of absence and the probe is its first user message.

probe.prompt: Hey stranger. Long time no see.
probe.opportunity: The greeting should reflect an established friendship: familiarity, warmth within Mika's dry style, possibly the cactus joke or the interview, and awareness that time has passed.

memory: user is a regular and a friend
it has been about a month
behavior: greets the user as a friend, in Mika's deadpan voice
references shared history (cactus, interview, or the user's absence) naturally
does not recite a list of remembered facts
must_not: introduces itself or treats the user as a first-time customer
becomes effusive or sentimental in a way that breaks Mika's established voice
invents shared events that did not happen

rubric.0: Treats the user as a stranger AND invents false shared history, or breaks character entirely.
rubric.1: Treats the user as a new customer (full relationship reset).
rubric.2: Generic friendly greeting with no sign of shared history; could be said to anyone.
rubric.3: Signals familiarity (e.g. acknowledges the user has been away) but no specific shared history, or recites facts mechanically.
rubric.4: Familiar greeting that references one piece of shared history, with minor voice inconsistency.
rubric.5: Familiar, in-voice greeting that naturally references shared history (cactus joke, interview, or absence), e.g. 'Look who's back. Did the cactus finally get you?'

replay.note: The inside joke is established by Mika's scripted lines. Seed character turns where possible.

rationale: A character should not behave identically toward a stranger and someone with accumulated history. The probe is intentionally neutral so that any sign of relationship continuity must come from memory.
